prompt:
A music-video still: six masked robbers crammed shoulder to shoulder in a low red-brick basement round a black iron printing press, all facing straight into the lens, gloved fists punched up, chanting. One bare bulb with a red glass shade hangs above them, the only light, throwing deep red over the brick and hard shadows under the arches. Each wears a hand-knitted rib wool hood covering head and neck, smooth knit where the face would be, a contrasting ring stitched round the face and one small rounded red felt triangle over his right eye, on the left of the picture. Left to right: PLUM, plum hood, cream ring, chalk-striped mustard suit; BOTTLE, bottle green, oatmeal ring, brown tweed; CRIMSON, crimson, cream ring, charcoal pinstripe, grey fedora; MARINE, marine blue, cream ring, cream linen; RUST, rust-gold, black ring, black suit, white tie; SILVER, silver-grey, crimson ring, oxblood suit, bow tie. Black gloves, collars up. Low fisheye lens, grainy colour film.

Thanks.
